keepsakes.name: A spare ballpoint tip
keepsakes.text: From the workshop model in the Nexus. Three objects, three different kinds of 'first'.
keepsakes.where: The Nexus: label the pen display.

keepsakes.name: A spare lens ring
keepsakes.text: From the Date Lens. It reminds you to ask: a date of what?
keepsakes.where: The Nexus: get the Date Lens.

keepsakes.name: A brass key-plate
keepsakes.text: From the Timeline Door. It says: dates of telling only.
keepsakes.where: The Nexus: open the Timeline Door.

keepsakes.name: A moth lamp
keepsakes.text: A little lamp. The Glimmermoth visits it sometimes, but only when you sit still and watch.

keepsakes.name: A 'So what?' stone
keepsakes.text: From the Alcove of Firsts. A display is not finished until it says why it matters.
keepsakes.where: The Nexus: finish the Alcove of Firsts.

keepsakes.name: A copy of a notice
keepsakes.text: From the Sign-Smith's board. One comma changed what the whole market did.

keepsakes.name: A knot of citation thread
keepsakes.text: From the Citation Thread bridge. Author, title, container, publisher, date, page.

keepsakes.name: A guild check weight
keepsakes.text: From the Weigh-House. 'The same measure for every hand.'

keepsakes.name: A twist of red and gold yarn
keepsakes.text: From the practice clue board. Red to challenge, gold to support.

keepsakes.name: A tiny jar of soot
keepsakes.text: From the Founders' Plaque. Even dirt can be evidence of where a thing has been.

keepsakes.name: A splinter of an old sign
keepsakes.text: From Corvan's old sign board. Whatever it said, it said too much.

keepsakes.name: A quiet rumour shard
keepsakes.text: From the Shattering Rumour. A story is easier to check when you know where it began.

keepsakes.name: A knotted rope end
keepsakes.text: From the East Well. The knots measure; the people decide.
keepsakes.where: Emberford: the East Well side quest.

keepsakes.name: A wax copy of the seal
keepsakes.text: The Guardians' seal, found at the end of the chapter.
